scope: Resource-only probe-cap amendment before new season scoring; no point-result selection
rule: Choose the largest cap from 12, 8, 6 for which 38 times the largest per-policy mean preflight time times cap/12 fits the existing 900-second path guard. Linear scaling is a resource estimate, not a guarantee or football criterion.
required_validation: Fresh uniform 24-case source-only preflight with the selected cap before the full 24-season-path matrix; retain the original 24-case pilot and both failed preflights.
chip_fairness: Reserve capacity for one combined-schedule proposal when the fixed-work cap is 6–9; probe each eligible chip family before later dates. Duplicate schedules reuse the cache. Legacy wall-time behaviour is unchanged.
limitations: Fixed-work search may cost more than timed search; cap changes define a separate research policy. No promise of global optimality, identical CPU work or equal scores versus PR40.
